vectors.title: UploadPartCopy CopySourceIfMatch: matching ETag succeeds, wrong ETag returns PreconditionFailed
UploadPartCopy CopySourceIfModifiedSince: a past date copies, and a future date is ignored and copies too
vectors.description: The source test used now-1day and now+1day and expected the future date to fail with NotModified or PreconditionFailed. AWS ignores a future If-Modified-Since and completes the copy, so both steps expect success (fixed far-past and far-future dates stand in for the relative ones). The 412 PreconditionFailed arises only for a date after the source object's last-modified time that is not in the future.

vectors.title: UploadPartCopy CopySourceIfNoneMatch: non-matching ETag succeeds, matching ETag returns PreconditionFailed
vectors.description: AWS returns 412 PreconditionFailed when x-amz-copy-source-if-none-match matches the source ETag. The source test also accepted NotModified from other implementations.

vectors.title: UploadPartCopy CopySourceIfUnmodifiedSince: future date succeeds, past date returns PreconditionFailed
